description: Seamless Operation: The simple mode selection and updated icons make the system easy to use. With the new, user-friendly interface, navigating through options and finding what you need is a breeze. Users can quickly choose the mode they want without any hassle for smooth and efficient experience. Versatile Detection: This high-tech detection tool can accurately detect materials like metal, wood, and live wires inside your walls. It gives you exact measurements, so you know what’s behind the wall before you start drilling or cutting. This helps you avoid damaging anything hidden, like wires or pipes, and keeps you safe while working. Precise Results: It features a color-coded marking hole and center indicator to show the exact spot to drill or cut. The display provides key details like signal strength and the type of material, whether metal, live wire, or wood, helping you make safe and accurate decisions before you start working. Crafted to Endure: Withstand tough work conditions to the durable rubber shell that absorbs shocks and protects against bumps and drops. The IP54 rating also shields it from dust and water splashes, making it highly reliable in any environment. Dual Power Capability: The dual power function gives you flexibility by letting you use either regular alkaline batteries or a BA 3.7V 1.0Ah A Li-ion battery pack to run the device. This adaptability means the tool keeps working no matter the situation, ensuring you’re never without power. Enhanced Accuracy: The tool automatically adjusts its settings through calibration to ensure accurate measurements. It also gives you real-time feedback, so you instantly know how it’s performing and what the measurements are. Get the most precise and reliable data to achieve accurate results and avoid mistakes. Practical Applications: The BOSCH GMS 120-27 Professional Detector is perfect for finding metal pipes, wooden studs, and live wires behind walls. It’s useful for home renovations, installing shelves, mounting fixtures, fitting cabinets, installing heating systems, boilers, and plumbing works, ensuring precise detection of hidden elements to avoid damage. Compact and Portable: The compact, easy-to-handle size makes it convenient to carry around and store without taking up much space. The handle is designed to fit comfortably in your hand, making it easy to hold and use for longer periods without causing hand fatigue. Comprehensive Detection and Clear Feedback: The BOSCH GMS 120-27 Professional Detector features a broad detection range—up to 120 mm for metal and 38 mm for live wires—combined with a user-friendly, backlit LCD screen for easy reading. It also provides both audio and visual alerts to ensure that important signals are clearly communicated, even in low-light conditions.
